Location administrators can manage staff accounts within their assigned location using scoped roles. They do not gain access to unrelated locations. The permissions guide is attached and includes an example of the configuration for your operations team.

The permissions guide answers the location administration question. Please send a proposal for a sixty user pilot with pricing and evaluation duration. Procurement has not agreed a response date, but we would like the complete offer available for its review.

The requested sixty user pilot proposal is attached with pricing, evaluation duration, and the onboarding allowance. It answers the commercial details procurement requested. Please review the offer with your team and let us know your decision when the review finishes.

Thanks for sending the proposal. This is only an acknowledgement that your message reached me; I've no decision, review result, new question, or agreed later response date to share. Procurement has not yet provided a substantive response to the offer.

Following up once on the sixty user pilot proposal sent last Friday. We have not received a decision or a new question from procurement. The complete offer remains available, including the pricing and evaluation duration requested by your operations team.
